🔗 Combined Pool — LP + DP Scenario Planning
Treats 188mg LP + 200mg DP (or 47mg + 50mg) as a single pooled inventory of finished drug material. LP and DP are the same drug at different packaging stages, so both contribute to the pool. Only LP patient sales deplete the pool. MRP schedules additional DP batches when the pool projects below the target MOH.
FDP & DP — Inventory + Production with Safety Stock
Stacked monthly: FDP inventory (navy) + FDP production (Geron-blue = binding · green = non-binding) + DP inventory (gold) + DP production (purple = binding · green = non-binding). Lines (foreground): monthly demand (cyan), 1-yr rolling cumulative demand (red), 2-yr rolling cumulative demand (navy). Re-renders live on every scenario / supplier / sales-factor change.
Combined Pool — Inventory Projection
Combined beginning inventory = LP + DP. Only LP patient demand depletes the pool.
